//: MCP servers taken off every Mac's registration but kept within reach. slab/bin/mcp-hub.mjs serves this list as the `shelf` server: shelf_list browses it, shelf_tools reads a server's tools, shelf_call runs one. Nothing here starts until asked for, and it idles out like any hub child. An entry with command/args is callable through the shelf; one with only a url is listed with the line that registers it again. To retire a server, move its definition here; to bring one back for good, run its `restore` line and delete the entry.

dmgify.about: Plan, build and verify macOS .dmg installers for AC apps.
dmgify.why: No calls from Claude or Codex in 60 days.
dmgify.restore: move the entry back into toolchain/mcp/hub-servers.json and run: node slab/bin/mcp-hub.mjs --register

jukewizard.about: Drive the Juke Wizard player: list, play, pause, seek, speed.
jukewizard.why: No calls from Claude or Codex in 60 days.
jukewizard.restore: move the entry back into toolchain/mcp/hub-servers.json and run: node slab/bin/mcp-hub.mjs --register

roblox.about: Launch, capture and test the pinned Roblox experience.
roblox.why: No calls from Claude or Codex in 60 days.
roblox.restore: move the entry back into toolchain/mcp/hub-servers.json and run: node slab/bin/mcp-hub.mjs --register

chrome-devtools.about: Chrome DevTools protocol: pages, console, network, performance traces.
chrome-devtools.instead: claude-in-chrome for the signed-in browser, puppet for the warm CDP browser, frame for native windows
chrome-devtools.restore: claude mcp add --scope user chrome-devtools -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest --no-usage-statistics

chrome-devtools-chicken.about: Chrome DevTools on the chicken mini, over the fleet bridge.
chrome-devtools-chicken.why: Never called; was registered on neo only.
chrome-devtools-chicken.restore: claude mcp add --scope user chrome-devtools-chicken -- node toolchain/mcp/fleet-chrome-devtools.mjs --host=chicken --expected-user=jeffrey@fuser.studio

sketchup.about: Drive SketchUp through the sketchup-mcp bridge.
sketchup.why: Never called; was registered on neo only.
sketchup.restore: claude mcp add --scope user sketchup -- uvx --from sketchup-mcp --with mcp==1.10.0 sketchup-mcp

oskiewar-coach.about: The older oskiewar coach, run from the ac-jev-workshop checkout.
oskiewar-coach.why: 4 calls, none since 2026-10-19; the checkout exists on blueberry only.

exa.about: Exa's hosted web search and fetch.
exa.why: 6 Claude and 14 Codex calls, frisbee only.
exa.instead: ac-web-search, which wraps the same service behind AC's own interface
exa.restore: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user exa https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp

asana.about: Asana's hosted MCP: tasks, projects, comments.
asana.why: Never called; was registered on neo only. Needs an Asana sign-in.
asana.restore: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user asana https://mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp

diffusion.about: A local image diffusion server on port 3274.
diffusion.why: Never called, and nothing was listening on the port on neo or blueberry.
diffusion.restore: start the diffusion server, then: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user diffusion http://127.0.0.1:3274/mcp

oskiewar-stage.about: The oskiewar stage service on port 7792.
oskiewar-stage.why: Never called; not listening on frisbee or blueberry.
oskiewar-stage.instead: oskiewar (oskiewar_stage reads and steers the same service) and venue
